arrayEqual().b: The second array. The two are equal when they have the same length and each pair of elements is equal by `==`.

avg().arr: The array of numbers to average. An empty array, or one absent element, gives an absent mean.

clear().arr: The array to empty. It keeps its identity, so every name that refers to it sees it empty.
clear().t: A table made with `table()`. Every cell is emptied, so the panel can be rebuilt from scratch.

copy().arr: The array to copy. The copy is independent of it, though a copy of drawings holds the same drawings, not new ones.

element().i: The index to read, counting from 0. An index outside `0` to `size - 1`, or with a fractional part, stops the study with `OS4004`.

indexOf().v: The value to look for, compared with `==`. Search for `none` to find an absent element.

insert().i: The index to insert before, from 0 to `size(arr)`. Inserting at `size(arr)` adds to the end; anything larger is `OS4004`.
insert().v: The value to insert, of the array's element type.

pop().arr: The array to take the last element from. An empty array stops the study with `OS4004`, so test `size(arr) > 0` first.

push().v: The value to add at the end, of the array's element type.

remove().i: The index of the element to remove, counting from 0. An index outside `0` to `size - 1` is `OS4004`.

reverse().arr: The array to reverse, in place.

set().i: The index to write, which must already exist. Writing past the end is `OS4004`, not a way to grow the array.
set().v: The value to write, of the array's element type.

shift().arr: The array to take the first element from. An empty array stops the study with `OS4004`.

slice().arr: The array to copy a range from. It is not changed.
slice().from: The first index to copy, counting from 0. A negative or fractional bound stops the study with `OS4003`.
slice().to: The index to stop before, which is not included. A `to` past the end is cut back to the end.

sort().arr: The array to sort, in place.
sort().order: `"asc"` for smallest first or `"desc"` for largest first. Write it as a literal or take it from a menu `input()`.

unshift().v: The value to add at the front, where it becomes element 0.
